findings_observed.title: Do not render a zero duration when authorization is unavailable
findings_observed.trigger: missingauth Home/Live and final dede8c representative
findings_observed.impact: The rendered Duration field says 0 seconds although the authorization projection is missing. This violates missing-is-unknown and can mislead operators into treating absent authority as a zero-valued limit.
findings_observed.status: fixed and rechecked in combined final freeze

findings_observed.title: Expose shaped overview failure on Home
findings_observed.trigger: network_failure Home while Live renders This view is unavailable
findings_observed.impact: The fixture overview-summary carries FIXTURE_NETWORK_FAILURE but Home renders ordinary no-signal content without an unavailable/error notice, so a failed bounded summary can be mistaken for healthy empty data.
findings_observed.status: fixed and rechecked in combined final freeze
